name: Ash-wight
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition so quests can reference it. The bestiary stream's file sorts after this one and overrides it; delete this entry once that lands.
lore: The un-ended people of Greyfold. Weak, many, easily staggered. They still wave.

name: Hedge-wight
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition; the bestiary stream's definition overrides it.
lore: A farmer buried with his tools who did not stop working. Slow, huge poise, sweeps with a scythe.

name: Down wolf
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition; the bestiary stream's definition overrides it.
lore: Lean, grey-gold, circles, lunges when you turn away.

name: Roadside bandit
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition; the bestiary stream's definition overrides it.
lore: Tell them it was the Larkbourne Boys. Nobody remembers the Larkbourne Boys.

name: She Who Waits in the Nave
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition for quest references; the boss stream's definition overrides it.
lore: A marsh-hag priestess on a flooded altar. Her hymn heals her unless it is interrupted.

name: The Stone-Thrall King
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition for quest references; the boss stream's definition overrides it.
lore: Giant bone and rock that walks. What is left when a thing is taken back but its weight is not.

name: The Hart of Thorns
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition for quest references; the boss stream's definition overrides it.
lore: An antlered knight who has kept the Standing Moot longer than the Woodfolk have had a word for keeping.

name: The Last Cantor
notes: Narrative-stream minimal definition for quest references; the boss stream's definition overrides it.
lore: The holder of the wrong note. The antagonist, and the most sympathetic figure in Wickmere.
